description: Diagnose + recommend on six synthetic versions of each CLIC 2020 manifest image, against the route the design intends

clean.why: a sharp, low-noise 1024 px photo is above the 900 px low-res edge and should trip no flag, so recommend() returns no upscale ('no automatic restoration needed' when no face is found)

blur.why: Gaussian blur lowers the variance of the Laplacian below 120 -> softness -> Real-ESRGAN; 1024 px is not low-res, so x2

noise.why: sigma 15 noise raises the Immerkaer estimate above 6.0 -> noise -> Real-ESRGAN x2

lowres.why: long edge 256 px < 900 -> low resolution, and < 500 -> x4

soft.why: 4x down and bicubic up removes fine detail at 1024 px -> softness -> Real-ESRGAN x2

jpeg20.why: README routes global decay to Real-ESRGAN and restorers/upscale.py lists JPEG-compressed images among its targets, so the design intent is Real-ESRGAN x2. diagnose.py has no compression measure: this route is taken only if JPEG artefacts move the sharpness or noise estimate past a threshold

expected_mapping_written: before any image was diagnosed (this file is first written with it, then completed after the run)
route_compared: upscale decision of recommend(): 'no upscale', 'Real-ESRGAN x2' or 'Real-ESRGAN x4'; faces reported separately
code_readme_disagreements: README diagram: Diagnose asks 'localized defect?' and routes 'localized -> LaMa (brush)'. diagnose.py measures no localized defect; when no flag and no face is found, recommend() only adds a reason suggesting the Brush Repair tab.

README routes 'global decay' to Real-ESRGAN, and restorers/upscale.py lists JPEG-compressed images among its targets, but diagnose.py has no compression or blocking measure; its only signals are sharpness, noise, resolution and faces.
diagnose.py says its thresholds are 'tuned for typical consumer / scanned old photos'; neither the code nor the README records what they were tuned on.

parameters.base: PIL LANCZOS resize to a 1024 px long edge (images smaller than that are enlarged; flagged enlarged_to_1024)
parameters.soft: degradations.downscale(factor=4), then PIL BICUBIC back to the base size
parameters.face_detector: diagnose._FaceDetector: facexlib retinaface_resnet50, conf 0.9, full image, no resize

provenance.scripts_committed: in the same commit as these results
provenance.git_dirty_tracked_paths_note: corrected after the run: eval_common.provenance() sliced the first 'git status --porcelain' line after git() had stripped its leading space, recording 'ocs/index.md'. The path is docs/index.md (an uncommitted text edit, not read by this evaluation). Fixed in eval_common.py in a later commit.
